blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thirty percent of Filipinos disagree with the statement, “A person like me cannot do anything to reduce corruption in the government,” according to the latest survey of the Social Weather Stations (SWS). The second quarter 2026 SWS survey released on Thursday evening also showed that 52 percent agreed that they are unable to reduce corruption in the government, while 17 percent were undecided.
